scope: Shared-protocol question planning with structural metadata for every supplied partial model. No source biological fixture reuse, implementation or validated coverage.

defaults.data: Independent observed biological inputs with pinned rights, provenance and transformations. A corpus train split can contain a task-internal held-out evaluation; task-internal labels remain private.
defaults.acceptance: Freeze complete output schemas, identity and eligibility rules, numerical or metric criteria and independent checks before solver evaluation. No LLM judge.
defaults.reference: Native package scripts read the supplied observations; a passing reference proves feasibility, not that every model must produce identical predictions.
defaults.runtime: Bound a scientifically meaningful question for a measured <=30-minute solve. Publish any preprocessing/start-boundary adaptation and do not claim stages that the task does not execute.
defaults.status: All 350 supplied input structures are audited; biological endpoint and observed-data suitability gaps remain. The three cards are shared-protocol adaptations with zero per-system coverage assignments.
defaults.next_decision: Identify an independent observed system with adequate intervention coverage and biological provenance; anonymous structural similarity alone earns no workflow credit.

questions.scientific_question: Which reconstructed dynamical models explain independent observed responses and predict unqueried measured interventions while preserving uncertainty about nonidentifiable mechanisms?
questions.source_scope: Shared adaptive mechanism-reconstruction protocol. Choosing between two fully supplied models or fitting a fixed equation is a supporting component, not the complete source endpoint.
observed_input_requirements: Observed biological time-course measurements with independent replicates, units, intervention labels, measurement uncertainty and licensed model definitions.
proposed_artifact_requirements: model.xml: complete executable SBML with preserved observable/compartment identities and explicit units
simulation_spec.json or SED-ML: method, tolerances, sample times and condition application
query_ledger.jsonl: queried observed condition IDs and cumulative cost
predictions.tsv: condition_id, replicate_id, observable_id, time, predicted_value, unit, simulation_status
fit_and_identifiability.tsv: parameter or mechanism, bounds, estimate/profile, uncertainty and unresolved equivalences
questions.deterministic_verifier_design: Validate the submitted SBML with the actual native library, run its dynamics privately for every held-out observed condition and compute a frozen measurement-aware score over all required observables/times. Reject or explicitly penalize missing/nonfinite simulations; never report zero error when every simulation fails. Independently verify units, condition joins, query budget and selected numeric predictions. Structural recovery requires independent structural evidence; matching trajectories alone does not establish the true reaction graph.
questions.coverage_limit: Independent observed biological kinetics are required for the proposed training adaptation. Simulated model predictions are allowed outputs, but must not be relabeled as observed inputs. All 350 source systems retain biological-endpoint and evidence gaps; structural inspection alone adds no assignment or validated coverage.
required_incorrect_output_checks: Swap amount and concentration or ignore a nonunit compartment size.
Drop an observed species, time point or failed simulation from the scored denominator.
Return stored observation tables without an executable input-reading model.
Reuse unperturbed predictions for a changed intervention.
unresolved_before_assignment: Independent time-course accession, redistribution terms, measurements, units and uncertainty.
Mapping of observable signals to model states, including latent states and baseline conditions.
Complete numerical score, failure treatment and all accepted model-equivalence rules.
Native libSBML/simulator versions and a measured <=30-minute workflow.
required_endpoint_stages: Parse a native state/compartment specification and explicitly state which mechanisms are initially unknown.
Query or inspect eligible observed time courses under a fixed access budget.
Construct an executable SBML model with reactions or equivalent supported dynamics, kinetic expressions and fitted parameters.
Predict every private evaluation condition using the actual submitted model and report observationally indistinguishable alternatives.

questions.scientific_question: Which already measured intervention best distinguishes competing mechanisms under the observed noise and sampling design?

source_specific_decisions: Expose only existing measured conditions with acquisition costs; do not synthesize unmeasured interventions to expand the catalog.
A selected intervention may become solver-visible, while distinct outcomes remain private for final scoring. Record the disclosure boundary.
Use deterministic replay and a fixed budget; a query is not successful merely because the expected-information objective increases.

questions.scientific_question: Which kinetic parameters are identifiable from the observed sampling design, and which remain confounded?
questions.source_scope: Supporting identifiability component. Predictive equivalence and kinetic/structural recovery are separate claims; no per-system full-coverage assignment.
observed_input_requirements: Independent observed replicate time courses, known measurement scale and an explicitly specified bounded kinetic model.
proposed_artifact_requirements: Profile likelihood or sensitivity tables, fit constraints, parameter intervals, residuals and predictions under eligible parameter sets.
questions.deterministic_verifier_design: Recompute sensitivity/profile summaries and residuals; accept equivalent fitted parameter sets when predictions and stated identifiability pass. Do not demand one hidden parameter vector that observationally equivalent models cannot identify.

source_specific_decisions: Freeze structural versus practical identifiability scope, parameter bounds, observation model and profile criterion.
Finite noisy observations can leave several mechanisms compatible. Accept justified equivalent models rather than one arbitrary hidden parameter vector.
For an actual recovery score, independent structural evidence must establish the recovered feature; simulation fit is insufficient.

input_structure_audit.method: Streaming projection of supplied partial XML only; element/attribute counts and hashes. No libSBML validation or simulation.
interpretation: All 350 supplied partials omit reactions, kinetic laws, parameters, assignments, rules and events. Reconstructing missing mechanisms is broader than estimating parameters in a supplied model.
All species IDs are anonymized and all species names, annotations and notes are absent. The partial models do not expose biological system identity.
The source spans 2-786 species and 1-9 compartments. Size alone does not determine scientific difficulty or a <=30-minute runtime.
Initialization uses concentrations in 295 models, amounts in 50 and both modes across species in five. Preserve unit/compartment semantics instead of treating every value as concentration.
